svg.title: Conserved flow can oppose a reference arrow
svg.desc: Solved pressures are96,42,60,6mmHg at source,A,B,sink. The A-to-B reference flow is minus0.9L/min, meaning0.9L/min actually moves from B to A. Total source flow and sink flow are both6.3L/min.
